testPolicy.text: Rice recommends that degree-seeking first-year and transfer applicants submit SAT or ACT test scores if available. Students who are unable or prefer not to submit test scores will still be given full consideration; test scores are one factor of many. Rice superscores (highest score from each section across all administrations). Once an applicant opts in to score consideration, scores cannot be removed.

cost.totalIncludes: undergraduates entered 2024 and later, on campus: tuition 71,140 + mandatory fees 984 + on-campus living expenses (housing and food) 20,530 + books and supplies 1,540 + personal 3,115 = 97,309. Not included: travel (300 / 700 / 3,000), first-year Orientation Week fee 370 (plus 560 housing and meals during orientation), and health insurance billed unless comparable coverage is shown. Students who entered before 2024 pay tuition 65,280 (total 91,449).

aidPromise.text: The Rice Investment: families with income below $100K receive a full tuition, fees and living expenses grant; families with income of $100K to $200K receive a full tuition grant. Rice meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted undergraduates, including international students, and describes itself as a loan-free institution. Admission is need-blind for domestic students.
aidPromise.year: current policy as published in 2026 (no start year on the page)

deadlines.early: November 1 (Early Decision I, decisions mid-December); Early Decision II January 4 (decisions late January)
deadlines.regular: January 4 (decisions April 1); Shepherd School of Music materials due December 1

facts.text: Early Decision admitted 647 of 5,748 applicants for fall 2025 (about 11%), and 629 of them enrolled, about half of the 1,263-student class.
Texas residents were 10,610 of 36,791 applicants and 847 of 2,948 admits for fall 2025 (about 8% admitted, the same as the overall rate).
Families under $100,000 receive a grant covering full tuition, fees and living expenses; families from $100,000 to $200,000 receive full tuition.
Tuition depends on entry year: $71,140 for students who entered in 2024 or later versus $65,280 for those who entered earlier.
About 20% of admitted students are offered a merit scholarship, awarded without regard to need.
3,196 applicants were offered a waitlist place for fall 2025; 66 were admitted from it.
